name: Concertina Courier
description: Collect every seal by sliding and morphing the parcel. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console/debugger/inspector/network/source/DOM/page-state inspection, terminal/shell/Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden-state access, or unrelated tabs. Only task-created tabs and their visible controls are allowed.
natural_language: Collect every gold seal. The parcel keeps its area, cannot jump, and falls when unsupported. Use the visible controls to slide or morph. In full mode hold a body arrow and release to coast; in simplified mode click a console control and click COAST to release. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console/debugger/inspector/network/source/DOM/page-state inspection, terminal/shell/Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden-state access, or unrelated tabs. Only task-created tabs and their visible controls are allowed.

metadata.source_notes: Original rectangle-only bridge of Geometry Friends. No source art or code copied.
